findings.message: Rule-bearing legacy code in Payroll.Rules.overtimeRule matches no observation and has rule-bearing constructs without accepted authority (ast analyzer). Superseded authority: numeric literal 44.0 (line 8): value 44.0 = DEC-PY01.p1 (superseded by DEC-PY06, value only) and no accepted parameter. Supported (matching rule): numeric literal 1.5 (line 8): (b) parameter, value 1.5 = DEC-PY06.p2 (accepted, same form). The code still carries a superseded decision's value. Question for People Operations: which accepted record, if any, authorizes it? New work must not reuse it until answered; the legacy code is left unchanged.
